verdicts.reason: A leaves the headline and Shop button tiny and placed high, at about y=80 on a 198px canvas, so there is a large empty purple band below. Its right margin (about 80px) does not match the 24px left margin, and the button edges are jagged. B scales the type and button to fill the canvas, centres them vertically and gives equal side margins, so it reads as a deliberate banner; it needs only minor polish: the button edges are slightly aliased and the button is a bit large next to the headline.
